name: rooftop
_provenance: Live-RTK venue from the 2026-06-04 field session, restored VERBATIM from the operator's battle-station export (venue_rooftop.json). Pin headings are exactly as exported: on the map the S1/E1 arrows correctly point AT each other. CAUTION: a UI/robot heading-convention mismatch is suspected — interactive.html renders/stores heading mirrored about the venue bearing axis (tip compass = 2*bearing - heading_deg), while reposition_node treats heading_deg as a true compass bearing (E of N). So the robot may steer to the MIRROR of the on-screen arrow. Verify the actual drive direction on the robot (and/or fix the UI convention) before trusting this for an autonomous run.
